pairs: In anno quo ingressus est Thathan in Azotum,
In the year in which Tharthan entered into Ashdod,
and when he had fought against Ashdod and had captured it,
in tempore illo locutus est Dominus in manu Isaiæ,
the Lord spoke by the hand of Isaiah,
et solve saccum de lumbis tuis,
et calceamenta tua tolle de pedibus tuis.
and remove the sackcloth from your waist,
and take your shoes from your feet.”
Sicut ambulavit servus meus Isaias nudus et discalceatus,
Just as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot,
trium annorum signum et portentum erit super Ægyptum et super Æthiopiam;
as a sign and as a portent of three years over Egypt and over Ethiopia,
sic minabit rex Assyriorum captivitatem Ægypti,
so also will the king of the Assyrians force the captivity of Egypt,
Et timebunt, et confundentur ab Æthiopia spe sua,
And they will be afraid and confounded over Ethiopia,
their hope, and Egypt, their glory.
Et dicet habitator insulæ hujus in die illa:
And in that day, the inhabitants of a certain island will say:
ad quos confugimus in auxilium, ut liberarent nos a facie regis Assyriorum:
we fled to them for help, to free us from the face of the king of the Assyrians.
And now, how will we be able to escape?”
